short_prompt: Use the typed-water-hall geometry and common written art direction. Preserve explicit nozzle interfaces, header branches, pump inlet/outlet and supported external boundary connections. Keep all five workers and four vessels. Enrich planned architecture and joints without changing fluid routes. Inspect final pixels independently.
intent: A detailed two-module water-treatment hall with four vessels, two pumps, five workers and explicit supported piping. No hydraulic performance claim.

relationships: existing typed interfaces or localized attachments

negative_controls: Incorrect inventory; floating worker, displaced route endpoint, detached attachment or shaft/bearing misalignment where the actual fixture defines them.
limits: No final-pixel observation is supplied by these geometry commands.
Coverage partial remains partial; a schema number or successful loader cannot promote it to complete strict coverage.
No load, dynamics, hydraulic or biomechanical certification.
